findings.issue: The membership proof in `tangentHomPairL` ends with a 14-step chain of named-lemma rewrites (`add_apply`, `comp_apply` four times, `subtypeL_apply` twice, `coe_fst'`, `coe_snd'`, then h₁, h₄, h₂, h₃). Renaming any one of these lemmas breaks the proof.

summary: `sobolevL_prod` repeats the same argument for the `fst` and `snd` components and proves its key zeroth-order fact inline twice. `tangentHomPairL` ends in a 14-step chain of named-lemma rewrites that will break when Mathlib renames lemmas.
